# Contributing

This repository is the LaCobble GitHub profile: the README and the SVG graphics generated by `scripts/`.
Outside contributions are not expected, but a broken graphic or link is welcome as an issue.

Workflow for changes:

1. Branch from `main` (`type/topic`, e.g. `fix/langs-overflow`).
2. [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/): `type(scope): description`.
3. Check locally: `pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt`, then
   `cd scripts && GH_TOKEN=… python build_all.py LaCobble` (see [docs/SETUP.md](../docs/SETUP.md)).
4. Open a PR with the template; it is squash-merged once CI is green.

The app catalogue (`apps.toml`) is curated by hand on purpose: never generate it from the GitHub API.
